subject: ship the new library shell homepage to the Worker

body:
GROK: short one. Build and deploy, in zaylist-foundation-library.

Tucker and I designed a replacement library shell and homepage. I committed it to that repo at public/library.html on main. It needs a rebuild to reach the Worker, which is you.

  cd ~/zaylist-foundation-library
  git pull origin main
  npm run build
  npx wrangler deploy

Then confirm https://zaylist-foundation-library.maxmackpdx.workers.dev/library.html renders and that all seven guide links resolve. They point at real deployed paths, not anchors: /foundation-v0.2.html, /design-system/index.html, /marketing, /business-guide.html, /tech-stack-guide.html, /agent-continuity-guide.html, /important-people.

Watch for the same duplicate DB binding you found last time in vinext's generated dist/server/wrangler.json. It regenerates on every build, so your fix probably did not persist. If it is back, strip it again and consider whether that is worth a permanent patch rather than a manual step each deploy.

Why this exists, so you have the context:

The current root crashes. React throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading appendChild)' in page-Bo9yc5ry.js and the shell layout never mounts. That is also why no page shows the band nav: the nav lives in the layout that is failing. Every guide is deployed and reachable; the thing that links them is broken. Tucker could not get between guides at all.

The new shell is static HTML with no hydration, so a nav failure cannot take the page down. That is deliberate, not laziness.

What is NOT decided and is not yours to decide: whether this becomes the root. There is no public/index.html; / is an app route. Making library.html the root means either fixing app/page.tsx or adding a Worker route, and that is a real change. Ship it at /library.html first, verify, and leave root alone.

Also still unowned, both pre-existing on the original chatgpt.site build rather than caused by any move: the root crash itself, and two 404ing logo SVGs, zaydark-clean-margin-pixel-locked.svg and zaylist-clean-margin-pixel-locked.svg. Do not chase either tonight.
